title: Provenance
description: Attached to every artifact so a reviewer can jump from any claim back to the exact agent version and session that produced it.

session_id.description: Managed Agents session id (sesn_...). Deep-links to the Console trace.

thread_id.description: Set when produced by a subagent thread inside a multiagent session.

outcome_iterations.description: How many grader iterations the platform outcome loop ran before 'satisfied'.

inputs.description: Content hashes of the upstream artifacts this one was produced from, for reproducibility and cache keys in evals.
